1.c4 e5 2.e3 Nf6 3.f4 exf4 4.Nf3.strategy: A gambit: White refuses to retake and develops, hoping open lines and a lead in development repay the pawn. Black can keep the pawn, and White's compensation does not obviously justify the sacrifice.
1.c4 e5 2.e3 Nf6 3.f4 exf4 4.Nf3.name: English Opening: King's English Variation, Kahiko-Hula Gambit
